page_title: MAR 3-0 HAV | Marseille v Le Havre 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) takes it short.
90+1' Le Havre can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Abdoul Bamo Meite (Marseille) on for Iliman Ndiaye.
89' It's time for a substitution. Emran Soglo (Marseille) comes on in place of Ismaila Sarr.
88' Gennaro Gattuso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bilal Nadir (Marseille) replacing Chancel Mbemba.
86' Substitution. Abdoulaye Toure is replaced by Nolan Mbemba (Le Havre).

84' 3 - 0 Goal! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang displays great vision and sends a pass to Ismaila Sarr (Marseille), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 3:0.

80' What an opportunity! Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes low towards the middle of the goal, but Arthur Desmas reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinha (Marseille) replaces Amine Harit.
77' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for a foul.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Azzedine Ounahi departs the field of play to be replaced by Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille).
73' Le Havre failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
70' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Josue Casimir will be replaced by Issa Soumare (Le Havre).
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mohamed Bayo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
69' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
65' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
64' The game is interrupted. Josue Casimir (Le Havre) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

63' Marseille are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
59' Here is a change. Loic Nego is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Nabil Alioui (Le Havre).
59' The substitution is prepared. Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yassine Kechta.
59' A pass into the penalty area from Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is out of play. Marseille win a corner kick.
57' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Amine Harit (Marseille).
56' The ball is cleared after Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
55' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.
53' Great chance! Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
50' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
50' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Leonard blows his whistle for an infringement.

49' Iliman Ndiaye (Marseille) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Arthur Desmas to get hold of the ball.
47' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
46' The free kick from long range, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Le Havre.
46' Thomas Leonard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A player from Marseille commits a rough challenge. Thomas Leonard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
44' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

44' The referee blows his whistle, Marseille are awarded a corner kick. Amine Harit (Marseille) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
40' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!

38' What a poor attempt! Valentin Rongier (Marseille) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
37' The resulting corner, taken by Jonathan Clauss (Marseille), comes to nothing.

37' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) smashes a first-time shot a goal from inside the box, but it's bravely blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Marseille.
35' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
31' Loic Nego (Le Havre) commits a rough foul. Thomas Leonard stops the game and makes a call.
29' The linesman raises his flag. Michael Murillo (Marseille) is adjudged offside.
25' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game. One of the players from Le Havre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
24' Le Havre are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
24' One of the Marseille players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
21' 2 - 0 GOAL - 2:0! Amine Harit found Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Arthur Desmas off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
18' 1 - 0 This is definitely not what Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:0.
18' Thomas Leonard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) and blew his whistle.
17' Thomas Leonard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre).
15' Amine Harit (Marseille) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar.
13' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
12' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Leonard had an easy-decision to make.
11' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Le Havre was in an offside position.
10' The free kick picks out Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) in space, but his close-range header flies miles past the right post.
9' Ismaila Sarr (Marseille) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
6' Jonathan Clauss (Marseille) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
3' The Marseille players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Marseille will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
